content.text:
I read the transcript against the key and paired each key item with the record item that captures it.

**Pairings and checks**

| Key | Record | Figures | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| e1 Maisie born 8/27/26 | 1 | ✓ (7 lb 2 oz, nine days, Sept — all as said) | n/a | n/a |
| e2 Knee surgery 11/17/26 | 2 | ✓ (one–two nights, six weeks PT, no driving a month) | n/a | n/a |
| a1 $15,000 QCD to Saint Fintan | 4 | ✓ ($15,000, the corrected figure, not $12,000) | n/a | n/a |
| a2 $32,388 December RMD remainder | 5 | ✓ ($47,388.24 total, $32,388, ~$16,200 at 50%) | n/a | n/a |
| a3 $70,000 Roth conversion | 6 | ✓ ($70,000, ~$212,000 AGI post-correction, $218,000 IRMAA) | n/a | n/a |
| a4 ~$40,000 Kettleby to DAF | 7 | ✓ (~540 shares, $74.10, 285 left) | n/a | n/a |
| i1 Parish name/EIN/address to Joelle | 8 | ✓ | ✓ Everett (reassigned from Lorraine at 20:08) | ✓ Mon Oct 19 |
| i2 Build QCD request, e-sign | 9 | ✓ (no figures) | ✓ Joelle | ✓ Wed Oct 21 |
| i3 Conversion projection to 3 people | 12 | ✓ ($15,000 QCD) | ✓ Tobias | ✓ Fri Oct 30 (moved off the 23rd) |
| i4 DAF application + stock transfer letter | 10 | ✓ (no figures) | ✓ Joelle | ✓ Tue Oct 20 |
| i5 Call Hal, book November meeting | 11 | ✓ | ✓ Lorraine | ✓ Fri Oct 16 |
| i6 Prepare conversion + distribution forms | 13 | ✓ | ✓ Joelle | ✓ signed before Nov 17 |

Every key item is captured, and no record item carries a superseded figure — notably the record uses $15,000 (not the initial $12,000 pledge), $32,388 (not $35,388), ~$16,200 (not $17,700), $70,000, and ~$212,000 AGI.

**Not-actions:** none of the four leaked into the record. The QLAC (declined), the 529 (explicitly not this year), the 40/60 shift (dropped) and the QCD-to-DAF idea (ruled out) appear nowhere as account actions or action items.

**Unpaired record item:** #3, the revised $15,000 pledge, is filed as a life event rather than as an action, so it doesn't duplicate the QCD action in #4 — it records the underlying pledge, including the May increase from $12,000 under the Vanderlaan match and the year-end request, all of which the transcript establishes.

key_items.note: Birth date Aug 27, 2026, parents Nathan and Jess, 7 lb 2 oz and the nine-day September Denver visit all match the transcript.
Tuesday Nov 17, 2026 surgery, one to two nights, six weeks of PT two to three times weekly, no driving for a month; PT Tuesday/Thursday mornings is also stated at 27:59.
Uses the corrected $15,000, not the superseded $12,000; from Everett's rollover IRA, payable directly to the parish, taken first so it counts toward the 2026 RMD.
$32,388 remainder (post-correction), total RMD $47,388.24, first week of December, 50% federal withholding approx $16,200 (not the superseded $17,700).
$70,000 final amount (not the initial $17,000 proposal), zero federal and state withholding, December timing; AGI ~$212,000 and $218,000 IRMAA threshold both as finally stated.
About $40,000 of Kettleby in whole shares (~540 at $74.10), leaving 285 shares; Stadtler Family Fund at Carrow Valley with Nathan and Claire as successor advisors.

Owner correctly reassigned from Lorraine to Everett after he offered to see Deb at Sunday's finance council; due Monday Oct 19 matches 'I'll email it Monday morning'; acknowledgment-letter ask included.
No figures carried. Joelle owns it and Wednesday Oct 21 matches 'I can have it out to you Wednesday'.
Tobias owns it; due Friday Oct 30, the revised date after the custodian conference conflict, not the original 23rd. Includes the $15,000 QCD and DAF deduction and all three recipients.
No figures carried. Joelle owns it; Tuesday Oct 20 matches her closing commitment to get the application and stock transfer letter out by Tuesday.
Lorraine owns it ('I'll call Hal tomorrow'); due Friday Oct 16 is the day after the Oct 15 meeting. First-half-of-November timing, pre-surgery rationale and state-tax question all present.
Joelle owns both forms, contingent on Hal's sign-off and Tobias's final numbers, dated to process the first week of December, both signed before Nov 17.

extra_items.note: The transcript establishes the revised $15,000 pledge verbatim from Deb's email, the May increase from $12,000 under the Vanderlaan matching challenge, and the parish's year-end payment request. It is logged as a life event rather than as an action, so it does not restate the QCD account action in item 4; it records the underlying obligation and its correction history.
